channel.title: Korea Travel, Local View
channel.description: Getting around Korea, explained from a local point of view.

item.title: Do You Need a K-ETA for Korea? The 2026 Rules Explained
item.description: Who needs a K-ETA to visit Korea, which 22 countries are exempt through December 31, 2026, what it costs, and how long approval takes.

item.title: How to Get a Tax Refund in Korea as a Tourist
item.description: Korea's immediate, downtown, and airport tax refunds compared: the 15,000 won minimum, the per-receipt limits, who qualifies, and the airport steps.

item.title: Day Trips From Seoul You Can Actually Do by Train
item.description: What Korea's official rail network actually offers for a one-day trip from Seoul, based on Korea Tourism Organization and rail route information.

item.title: Getting from Incheon Airport to Seoul: Your First Day
item.description: A clear breakdown of the train, bus, and taxi options from Incheon International Airport into central Seoul, with travel times and costs.

item.title: T-money and Seoul Public Transport Basics
item.description: How T-money and other transportation cards work in Seoul, including where to buy them, how much they cost, and which pass fits different trip lengths.

item.title: Visiting Seoul's Palaces, Free Admission Days and the Hanbok Discount
item.description: The official rules for free palace entry in Seoul, including Culture Day, the hanbok dress requirements, and the combination ticket that covers five sites.
